statement: An Innovator Founder application must be supported by an endorsement letter from a Home Office approved endorsing body (or legacy endorsing body), issued no more than 3 months before the date of application and not withdrawn; the applicant must score 70 points, with a new-business applicant scoring 50 of them for a business plan and the endorsing body's assessment that the venture is innovative, viable, and scalable, and permission is granted for a maximum of 3 years (Immigration Rules Appendix Innovator Founder, INNF 1.2(d), 5.1, 6.1, 8.3, 14.1).
caveat: Endorsement is the endorsing body's own assessment and can be withdrawn, which can cut the permission short; checkpoint meetings with the endorsing body at 12 and 24 months, the endorsement fee, and the English (B2) and financial requirements apply on top. The Immigration Rules change at statements of changes, so check the live appendix; immigration decisions need counsel.
